_doc: Room recipes, by room key (dune-run --rooms). defaults apply to every room, with or without its own recipe (the look comes from style.json: game, then location). parts: people and objects painted into the room, redone in close-up (box in low-res pixels). A part with select (a sprite cut out by its colours, such as a guard) is pasted within its outline. A part without select is an area (the user's box: a rough indication, not a cut line): drawn with the room's description and look under its own text, blended with a wide soft edge, then its surroundings are repainted gently with the room's settings (harmonize: strength, default in defaults.part; false to skip) so it matches the room's detail and light. A part may name a character (recipes/cast.json), set its own strength, cond, soften, zoom, seed, margin (crop height / box height, default 1.4) darken (areas [x0, y0, x1, y1, factor] darkened in the close-up's guide only, e.g. a grey rifle beside a grey leg) and feather (soft edge of the paste-back, HD pixels; wide for a patch of floor) and close (fills warm gaps such as faces and hands inside the selected outline, in pixels). select (cool: cool-coloured pixels in the box, warm: strongly warm ones; default the whole box); context (false: the part is drawn from the pixel art alone, not over the room's rendering); same_as copies another part's recipe; copy_of reuses another part's HD result for the same sprite drawn again (flip for a mirrored copy; a box of another size scales it, e.g. the same statue nearer the camera; a box past the picture's edge is cut off). select: cool, warm or dark pixels in the box; grow widens that outline (low-res pixels) for small sprites. erase: true paints the part's pixels out of the pixel art, so the room is generated without it. An emblem part (emblem: NAME, a vector master NAME.svg in WORK/emblems or recipes/emblems) paints out the room's own version (red pixels in the box) and draws the master in the box in the original's colour (flip for a mirrored one); material adds an optional light pass describing the surface. A banner part (banner: NAME, a vector master like emblems; quad: its four corners TL, TR, BR, BL in low-res pixel edges; flip: the mirrored banner on the other side) is taken out before generation and drawn back last, warped onto the quad: clean edges, the same design everywhere. lights: small lamps of one colour (select blue|red|green) drawn back as glowing points after the colour anchoring, which would average them away (core, glow, gain). detail: a pass over the whole room after the close-up parts (enlarged by scale, repainted in tiles at low strength), so the room is as crisp as the parts and they do not pop out; emblems come after it.
